nodes.name: Settings
nodes.notes: The only node you edit: your bot token and your Telegram user ID. Never share this workflow while the token is in it.

nodes.name: Ask Telegram for new messages
nodes.notes: Long polling: Telegram holds the request up to 20 s and answers as soon as a message arrives. Nothing on the server is public: n8n reaches out, nothing reaches in.

nodes.name: If polling failed: remove old webhook
nodes.notes: Polling fails while a webhook is set on the bot (e.g. from an earlier setup). This removes it, so the next check works. Also fails, visibly, if the token is wrong.

nodes.name: Keep only my messages
nodes.notes: Ignores everyone except the owner. Returning nothing stops the run quietly when there are no new messages.

nodes.name: Confirm received
nodes.notes: Tells Telegram these messages arrived, BEFORE asking the AI, so a slow or failed answer can never make Jarvis reply twice.

nodes.name: Prepare each message
nodes.notes: Setup mode, commands (/start, /new) and non-text messages get a direct reply. Text gets the conversation history and goes to the brain.

nodes.name: Ask Jarvis's brain
nodes.notes: The gateway (Lesson 06), alias 'smart': best free model, automatic fallback. Pick your OpenAI-type credential (Base URL http://litellm:4000/v1) here: no key is written in the workflow.

main.node: If polling failed: remove old webhook
